intro.title: Tank cleaning for Pune homes, societies and factories.
intro.body: Shree Chintamani Services has been cleaning tanks across Pune since 2015. STP, water tanks, fire tanks, cooling towers, solar heaters — we handle it all. One call, free site visit, honest quote.

servicesSection.title: What we clean
servicesSection.subtitle: From your overhead tank to the STP in the basement — we clean everything that holds or moves water.

stp-fire-tank-cleaning.name: STP & Fire Tank Cleaning
stp-fire-tank-cleaning.short: Sewage Treatment Plant and Fire Reserve Tank cleaning for societies, hospitals and factories. Sludge removal, jetting, repair and compliance reports.
stp-fire-tank-cleaning.overview: We clean every kind of Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) and Fire Reserve Tank — from small society plants to large industrial systems. Sludge removal, high-pressure jetting, leak repairs, and compliance documentation. CPCB and MPCB safety rules followed every time.
features: Complete STP sludge removal from all chambers
Fire tank inspection, debris clearance and NOC support
High-pressure jet cleaning of walls, floor and baffles
Pipe, valve, aerator and diffuser repair
Odour control and disinfection after cleaning
Before/after photos and digital service report

water-tank-cleaning.name: Domestic & Drinking Water Tank Cleaning
water-tank-cleaning.short: Safe, hygienic cleaning of overhead tanks, underground sumps and drinking water tanks for homes, societies and offices.
water-tank-cleaning.overview: Overhead tanks, underground sumps, drinking water tanks — sediment, biofilm and harmful bacteria removed using high-pressure water jets and food-grade disinfectants. The water you drink and bathe in actually stays clean.
features: Manual removal of mud, sand and debris from the tank floor
High-pressure jet washing of walls and floor
Food-grade sanitisation that kills bacteria
Tank inspection — leaks, cracks, gasket condition
Suitable for both residential and commercial tanks
Before/after photos and digital service report

cooling-tower-cleaning.name: Industrial Tank & Cooling Tower Cleaning
cooling-tower-cleaning.short: Scale, biofilm and algae removal from cooling tower fills and industrial process tanks for factories, hotels and commercial buildings.
cooling-tower-cleaning.overview: Cooling towers lose efficiency fast when fills get blocked with algae, scale and dust. We remove the buildup with high-pressure jetting, clean the basin, check the fans and fills, and get the tower back to its original cooling capacity. Less power, lower water use.
features: High-pressure jet cleaning of fills and louvers
Basin sludge removal and full descaling
Algae and biofilm removal — Legionella risk control
Confined-space-entry trained technicians
Night-shift and weekend scheduling to avoid downtime
Industrial process tank cleaning also offered

solar-water-heater.name: Solar Water Heater Service & Repair
solar-water-heater.short: Servicing, descaling, tube replacement and full repair for all rooftop solar water heater systems. AMCs for societies and bungalows.
solar-water-heater.overview: Solar water heaters lose efficiency when tubes get scaled or broken. We service all brands and configurations — descale the tank, replace broken tubes, fix leaks, repair controllers. Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) available.
features: Evacuated tube cleaning and replacement
Tank descaling and inner-liner inspection
Valve, sensor and controller repair
Leak detection and plumbing fixes
Annual maintenance contracts (AMC) available
All major brands serviced

whyUs.title: Simple work, done right.
whyUs.subtitle: Ten years of tank cleaning in Pune. Same crew. Same standards. Every job.
pointsBody: Our quality system is audited against international standards — the same expected of hospitals and food processors.
Every operator has confined-space safety training, PPE and is covered by public liability insurance. No outside contractors.
You get before/after photos and a digital service certificate within 24 hours of every job — useful for society audits.
Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 9 PM. Emergency cleanups handled the same day where possible.

about.title: Ten years of cleaning Pune's tanks.
about.intro: Shree Chintamani Services started in 2015 with one truck and one promise: clean tanks properly, not just rinse them. Today our team handles STPs, water tanks, cooling towers and solar heaters across Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad and the surrounding areas. Most of our work comes through word-of-mouth — and that's how we like it.
about.missionBody: Make professional tank cleaning honest, affordable and properly done — for every customer, whether it's a one-tank household or a ten-tank factory.
about.visionBody: Be the most trusted name for STP and tank cleaning in Pune. Every customer gets a straight answer. Every job is finished properly.
